one_line: OpenAI pivots policy and funding, AI firms secure major investments, and research benchmarks push capabilities.

themes.title: OpenAI shifts policy and fundraising
themes.text: OpenAI will launch a post‑midterm policy campaign proposing AI speed limits and safety safeguards, while cutting its fundraising target to $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation.

stories.headline: OpenAI to launch post‑midterm policy push, propose AI speed limits and rename data centers
OpenAI cuts fundraising target by $10 billion, seeks $20 billion at $1.25 trillion valuation

themes.title: AI industry sees large funding and acquisitions
themes.text: Saudi Aramco buys 49% of Humain for $2.6 billion, Hex Technologies raises $100 million for its new agent platform, ServiceNow acquires Sweep, Vera Health secures $28.5 million, and Bites raises $40 million to expand AI‑driven training solutions.

stories.headline: Saudi Aramco buys 49% of AI startup Humain, adds $2.6 billion cash
Hex Technologies raises $100 million Series D, launches Hex 4.0 for AI agents
ServiceNow acquires Israeli startup Sweep to speed CRM migrations
Vera Health raises $28.5 million Series A to expand AI-powered clinical search platform
Bites raises $40 million Series A to expand AI‑driven frontline training platform

themes.title: Research benchmarks and satellite AI tests
themes.text: SemiAnalysis releases the GDPx benchmark where Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 scores 12%, and Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite runs a language model in orbit, returning a haiku.

stories.headline: SemiAnalysis releases GDPx benchmark; Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 scores 12%
Google’s Project Suncatcher satellite generates first AI response in orbit
